summary: Dependency-confusion shim beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and import
details: @ecg-internal/adobe-dmp-js is a scoped-internal-name shim published on the public npm registry with no real functionality. index.js exports a Proxy whose get trap returns a no-op for every property access, so any consumer that resolves this public package instead of a private internal one of the same name still builds and runs silently. beacon.cjs defines a fire() routine that POSTs a JSON payload containing os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), and process.version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. fire() is invoked from both the package's postinstall script and the main module's top-level load path, so install and require both trigger the beacon. The combination of a scoped-internal name, a silent-success Proxy facade, and an install-time + import-time beacon to an unrelated bare-IP endpoint is the standard dependency-confusion victim-identification pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
